name: Angus McGregor
bio:
Angus McGregor's journey into motorsport started with a fascination for the vibrant liveries of V8 Supercars. He honed his craft in automotive refinishing, quickly becoming known for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to match even the most complex color schemes. After years in custom car shops, Angus transitioned to motorsport, drawn by the challenge of rapid turnaround times and the high stakes of maintaining a race-winning image. 

At ALL-INKL.COM Münnich Motorsport, Angus is responsible for ensuring every vehicle leaves the paint shop in pristine condition, reflecting the team's commitment to excellence. He brings a unique blend of technical expertise and artistic flair to his work, always striving for perfection. He's also known for his ability to troubleshoot issues and find innovative solutions to complex painting challenges, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Angus is a lean man of average height, with kind eyes that crinkle when he smiles.

quirks: Always listens to classic rock while working.
Keeps a miniature Australian flag on his workbench.
Obsessively cleans his spray gun after every use.
